title: Auto-mode classifier calls re-write the whole transcript to cache every time (cache_read fixed at 2414, cache_write grows 6062→9893)
observed: Probable kiln defect (cost/latency); the mechanism has not been traced in code. Across 22 classifier calls in one auto session, the run log shows cache_read=2414 on every call while cache_write climbs with the transcript: 6062, 6467, 6760 … 9757, 9893. Each call pays a cache write for the full transcript instead of reading the previous prefix and writing only the delta. With the classifier on Opus (no modelRoles.fast), that is ~7-10k cache-write tokens per bash command.
expected: Put the cache breakpoint so that the growing transcript prefix is reused (cache_read grows, cache_write is only the new tail), or put the per-call action after the cached transcript.

fix.note: branch worktree-agent-af33998aae4701c16 60b6502; measured by simulating the API cache rules over faux-recorded requests, not live
